product_overview: Backend APIs for SMAART Minds providing email+OTP authentication with JWT issuance, and progressive multi-section registration management. The backend is intended to support the 3-day per-module learning structure (steps 0-9) described in the instructor guidance (see module breakdown on pages 1-9 of the implementation doc).
core_goals: Provide secure email-based authentication with OTP verification and JWT issuance for session management.
Support comprehensive registration storage (11 sections) and progressive saving/updating of individual registration sections.
Enable retrieval of registration details by email to power the frontend CoursePlayer and ModuleContentBuilder flows (implementation notes on page 7).
Expose clear error responses for developer-friendly integrations and enforce basic validation for OTP and registration payloads.

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Endpoints to send and verify signup/login OTPs, create registration records, and issue JWTs on successful login OTP verification.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/send-signup-otp with {"email": user@example.com} -> Receive 200 with message 'OTP sent' and delivery metadata
POST /api/auth/verify-signup-otp with {"email": user@example.com, "otp": "123456"} -> Receive 200 with verification success
POST /api/auth/register with full registration payload (email + required signup fields) -> Receive 201 with created registration id and record summary
POST /api/auth/send-signup-otp with {"email": invalid-email} -> Receive 400 with validation error 'Invalid email format'

POST /api/auth/send-signup-otp with {"email": existing_registered_email} -> Receive 200 with message 'OTP sent' (system may still allow OTP for verification) or 409 if registration already exists (implementation-specific)
POST /api/auth/verify-signup-otp with {"email": user@example.com, "otp": "wrong"} -> Receive 400 with error 'Invalid or expired OTP'
POST /api/auth/login with {"email": user@example.com} -> Receive 200 with message 'Login OTP sent' and OTP metadata
POST /api/auth/verify-login-otp with {"email": user@example.com, "otp": "123456"} -> Receive 200 with {"token": "<JWT>", "expiresIn": seconds}
POST /api/auth/login with {"email": unknown@example.com} -> Receive 404 with error 'User not found' or 400 indicating login cannot proceed
POST /api/auth/verify-login-otp with {"email": user@example.com, "otp": "expired"} -> Receive 400 with error 'Invalid or expired OTP'

features.name: User Management API (Registration)
features.description: Save and update comprehensive registration details (multi-section form) and fetch registration records by email for profile and course onboarding.
user_flows: POST /api/users/register-details with full 11-section payload -> Receive 201 with saved registration record id and summary
GET /api/users/register-details/:email with a registered email -> Receive 200 with full registration document (all saved sections)
GET /api/users/register-details/:email with a non-existent email -> Receive 404 with error 'Registration not found'
PATCH /api/users/register-section with {"email": user@example.com, "section": "personal", "data": {...}} -> Receive 200 with updated section confirmation
PATCH /api/users/register-section with {"email": user@example.com, "section": "documents", "data": invalid_data} -> Receive 400 with validation errors indicating required fields missing
POST /api/users/register-details with missing required sections or malformed payload -> Receive 400 with validation error details
PATCH /api/users/register-section with {"email": unknown@example.com, ...} -> Receive 404 with error 'Registration not found'
